bio.text: Johnny Olszewski, Jr., was sworn into the U.S. House in January 2025 and represents Maryland's 2nd Congressional District.
He began his career as a public-school teacher, served in the Maryland House of Delegates for over nine years, and was twice elected Baltimore County Executive.
He holds a bachelor's degree from Goucher College, a master's from George Washington University and a Ph.D. in public policy from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County.
Olszewski lives in eastern Baltimore County.
